description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different training methods, with the x-axis listing the categories 'Standard', 'Self-RAG', 'FactTune', 'CInGS (w/)', and 'CInGS' in that order. The y-axis is labeled 'Average Performance' and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The 'Standard' bar is orange and has a value of approximately 52; the 'Self-RAG' bar is brown and has a value of around 54; the 'FactTuneCInGS (w/)' bar is green and has a value of approximately 51; the 'CInGS (w/)' bar is blue and has a value of about 53; and the 'CInGS' bar is dark blue and has a value of around 58. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and are sorted in the order they appear on the x-axis, with no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
